entities.name: Goblins
entities.description: A species of diminutive humanoids found across the Multiverse, usually red-aligned, passionate and chaotic.

entities.name: Kyren
entities.description: The goblin ruling class of Mercadia City, descended from Dominarian goblins left to guard the Thran council members.

entities.name: Mercadia City
entities.description: The city where the Kyren held total control over the figurehead Magistrate.

entities.name: Squee
entities.description: A Dominarian goblin regarded centuries later as a cultural hero of the Kyren.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: The owner of the ship Recreant, destroyed by Ramos.

entities.name: Recreant
entities.description: Volrath's ship, destroyed by the dragon engine Ramos.

entities.name: Ramos
entities.description: A dragon engine that intercepted and destroyed Volrath's ship.

entities.name: Skyship Weatherlight
entities.description: The ship whose flight from Mercadia City prompted Ramos's intervention.

entities.name: Rebbec
entities.description: A Thran figure who left goblins in Mercadia with Dyfed.

entities.name: Dyfed
entities.description: A Thran figure who left goblins in Mercadia with Rebbec.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: A power the Kyren became allies with.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: A plane the Kyren became allied with and where moggs were bred.

entities.name: Moggs
entities.description: Large, savage goblin hybrids bred for battle by the evincars of Rath.

entities.name: Evincars
entities.description: The rulers of Rath who bred moggs.

entities.name: Boggarts
entities.description: Goblins of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor, mischievous hedonists in Lorwyn and feral marauders in Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Redcaps
entities.description: Malicious goblins of Shadowmoor and Eldraine who dye caps red with blood.

entities.name: Hobgoblins
entities.description: Civilized goblins who appear only in Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Spriggans
entities.description: Green-aligned goblins of Shadowmoor that can grow gigantic.

entities.name: Stream hoppers
entities.description: Lorwyn boggarts mutated by the Great Aurora into one-eyed, one-armed, one-legged creatures.

entities.name: Akki
entities.description: Goblins of Kamigawa's mountains with turtle-like shells.

entities.name: Deep Goblins
entities.description: Translucent goblins native to the caverns of Ixalan.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: The plane where boggarts are one of eight tribes.

entities.name: Shadowmoor
entities.description: The dark version of Lorwyn.

entities.name: Great Aurora
entities.description: The event that transformed Lorwyn into Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: The plane where redcaps feud with dwarves.

entities.name: Assault on Delverhaugh
entities.description: A massive food fight caused by the dwarf-redcap feud.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: A plane with many goblin nations including Aerona, Otaria, Shiv and Terisiare.

entities.name: Rundvelt goblins
entities.description: A notorious Aerona goblin tribe that mastered rock sleds and siege equipment.

entities.name: Pashalik Mons
entities.description: A leader of the Rundvelt goblins who brought them unrivaled unity.

entities.name: Dochyel
entities.description: A famous sledder who improved rock sleds.

entities.name: Flarg Goblins
entities.description: Goblins of the Flarg who threatened Terisiare during the Dark Age.

entities.name: Knights of Thorn
entities.description: Knights who hunted goblins and orcs and eradicated the Flarg goblins.

entities.name: Battle of Pitdown
entities.description: A battle in which the Flarg goblins surprise-attacked the forces of Ghed and Alsoor.

entities.name: Lord Ith
entities.description: A lord who helped the Knights of Thorn eradicate the Flarg goblins.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: A figure from Giva Province present at the Battle of Pitdown.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion of Dominaria in which goblins joined human forces and moggs were used.

entities.name: Krark
entities.description: The goblin founder of the Krark-Clan who found another world in Mirrodin's depths.

entities.name: Krark-Clan
entities.description: A clan mostly of outcasts among the Oxidda goblins.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The metal plane where goblins have patches of metal on their skin.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: The figure whose arrival ended the fights between Shivan goblins and viashino.

entities.name: Izzet goblins
entities.description: Goblins whose entire tribe joined the Izzet League.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: The Ravnican guild that bought the goblin tribe.

entities.name: Krokt Clan
entities.description: Ravnican goblins affiliated with the Cult of Rakdos.

entities.name: Krokt
entities.description: The goblin god of bad luck.

entities.name: Tuktuk
entities.description: A goblin explorer who returned as a magical replica golem to lead the Tuktuk tribe.

entities.name: Tuktuk tribe
entities.description: A Zendikari goblin tribe of relic-using shamans.

entities.name: Zada
entities.description: A goblin who ate Tuktuk and subsumed his leadership.

entities.name: Lavastep
entities.description: An industrious, warlike goblin tribe of Akoum that took shelter underground after the Eldrazi emerged.

entities.name: Grotag
entities.description: The cleverest of Zendikar's goblin tribes, who domesticated animals.

entities.name: Grenzo
entities.description: A goblin of Fiora who became Dungeon Keeper of Brago.

entities.name: Brago
entities.description: A figure of Fiora whose death led to goblin gangs stalking the city.

entities.name: Auntie Jowl
entities.description: The Auntie leading the Squeaking Pie warren.

entities.name: Squeaking Pie warren
entities.description: A boggart warren known for culinary adventurousness.

events.summary: The Kyren, once guardians of Thran council members, grow corrupt and become allies of Phyrexia and Rath.
events.quote: They are the descendants of a group of Goblins from Dominaria during the time of the Thran who were left in Mercadia

events.summary: Ramos intercepts and destroys Volrath's ship Recreant as the Weatherlight flees the city.
events.quote: the dragon engine Ramos intercepted Volrath

events.summary: A revolution sweeps Mercadia City after the destruction of the Recreant.
events.quote: A revolution was then triggered that swept the city.

events.summary: Squee comes to be regarded as a cultural hero of the Kyren.
events.quote: the Dominarian goblin Squee would come to be regarded as a cultural hero of the Kyren

events.summary: The dwarf-redcap feud boils over in the Assault on Delverhaugh.
events.quote: The feud boiled over in a massive food fight known as the Assault on Delverhaugh

events.summary: The Flarg goblins surprise-attack the forces at the Battle of Pitdown.
events.quote: they made a surprise attack on the fighting forces of Ghed and Alsoor

events.summary: The Knights of Thorn, helped by Lord Ith, eradicate the Flarg goblins at the end of the Ice Age.
events.quote: Flarg Goblins were locked in a heated battle with the Knights of Thorn and were eventually eradicated by them at the end of the Ice Age with the help of Lord Ith

events.summary: Sarpadian goblins and orcs destroy the dwarven nations.
events.quote: They and the Sarpadian orcs destroyed the dwarven nations of the continent.

events.summary: Aerona goblins join their one-time human enemies against the Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: joined forces with their one-time human enemies during the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria and were trained as soldiers

events.summary: Moggs are used as soldiers by the Stronghold in the Phyrexian Invasion; survivors find freedom afterward.
events.quote: They were used by the Stronghold as soldiers for the Phyrexian Invasion, but after the war, the few surviving moggs found freedom.

events.summary: The Great Aurora transforms Lorwyn into Shadowmoor, turning boggarts into animalistic marauders.
events.quote: After the Great Aurora transformed Lorwyn into Shadowmoor, the boggarts changed from troublesome tricksters to animalistic marauders.

events.summary: Krark finds a way into Mirrodin's depths and another world there, per legend.
events.quote: Krark was a goblin who, legend states, found a way into the depths of Mirrodin and found another world there.

events.summary: The Izzet League buys the entire goblin tribe, impressed by their cleverness, per legend.
events.quote: The cleverness of the ancient goblins impressed the magelords enough that the Izzet League purchased the entire tribe outright.

events.summary: Tuktuk returns as a golem replica and becomes leader of his tribe.
events.quote: when the goblin explorer Tuktuk returned in the form of a magical replica golem

events.summary: Zada eats Tuktuk and takes his leadership of the tribe.
events.quote: Zada ate Tuktuk and subsumed his leadership of the tribe

events.summary: The Lavasteps flee the Eldrazi into the deepest parts of Akoum.
events.quote: The Lavasteps were hit hard by the emergence of the Eldrazi and sought shelter in the deepest parts of Akoum.

events.summary: Goblin gangs stalk Fiora's city after Brago's death.
events.quote: violent Goblin gangs stalked the city, stirring up unrest and plundering

events.summary: Grenzo secures a post as Dungeon Keeper of Brago.
events.quote: the goblin Grenzo managed to secure himself a position as Dungeon Keeper of Brago

relations.note: The Kyren became allies of Phyrexia and Rath.
relations.quote: becoming allies with Phyrexia and Rath

relations.note: The Kyren were its ruling class.
relations.quote: The Kyren were the ruling class in Mercadia City
The Krark Clan is named after its founder Krark
Bred mostly from goblins for nothing but battle by the evincars of Rath
their entire tribe joined the Izzet League
One such leader was Pashalik Mons
The warren is led by Auntie Jowl
the Tuktuk tribe gained a new leader when the goblin explorer Tuktuk returned

relations.note: The clan is named after the goblin god of bad luck.
relations.quote: The Krokt Clan is named after Krokt, the goblin god of bad luck.
